events.title: Independent project adapts EmbeddingGemma 2 for speech transcription
events.title_zh: 独立项目把 EmbeddingGemma 2 改造成语音转写模型
events.summary: An independent macOS project adapts EmbeddingGemma 2's audio encoder for speech transcription by training a small reader and punctuation model. The project reports roughly 5% word error rate and one hour of audio processed in about 13 seconds on a base MacBook Air. It distributes a free app, but no reproducible training code, test set or independent comparison is exposed.
events.summary_en: An independent macOS project adapts EmbeddingGemma 2's audio encoder for speech transcription by training a small reader and punctuation model. The project reports roughly 5% word error rate and one hour of audio processed in about 13 seconds on a base MacBook Air. It distributes a free app, but no reproducible training code, test set or independent comparison is exposed.
events.summary_zh: 一个独立 macOS 项目保留 EmbeddingGemma 2 的音频编码器，只训练小型 reader 与标点模型，把它改造成语音转写工具。项目称词错率约 5%，基础款 MacBook Air 处理一小时音频约需 13 秒。它提供免费应用，但没有公开可复现训练代码、测试集或独立对比。
events.why_it_matters: The demo is an inventive reuse of a multimodal embedding model, but an opaque app and author-only metrics do not support engineering adoption. Record the community signal and wait for reproducible artifacts.
events.why_it_matters_en: The demo is an inventive reuse of a multimodal embedding model, but an opaque app and author-only metrics do not support engineering adoption. Record the community signal and wait for reproducible artifacts.
